decisioni.proposta: A defensible note for each hard call an NP makes (differential, abnormal result, consultant who never comes, capacity, AMA, discharge, telehealth, prescription): the weak note beside its defensible rewrite, and the elements the note must contain. It makes reasoning visible on the record; it does not make anyone lawsuit-proof.
